"""Temporary JSON process controls; --before records prior auditor blind spots."""
import base64
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode/lean-native-v2-R04/fixtures/profiles/playwright')
scratch = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode')
before = '--before' in sys.argv
old_input = json.loads((root / 'capture-receipt.json').read_text())
new_input = json.loads((root / 'browser-recovery-receipt.json').read_text())
labels = ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'duration-string', 'errors-object', 'annotations-object', 'viewport-float')
if not before:
    labels += ('parallel-bool', 'duration-bool', 'duration-nan', 'duration-negative', 'stdout-object',
               'stderr-invalid-element', 'attachments-object', 'optional-error-wrong-type', 'location-line-bool',
               'empty-results', 'cases-object')
controls = []

def raw_tests(report):
    tests = []
    def visit(suites):
        for suite in suites:
            visit(suite.get('suites', []))
            for spec in suite.get('specs', []):
                tests.extend(spec['tests'])
    visit(report['suites'])
    return tests

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='R04-type-controls-', dir=scratch) as directory:
    for label in (*labels, 'original'):
        old, new = copy.deepcopy(old_input), copy.deepcopy(new_input)
        name = 'R04-browser-success-list' if label == 'viewport-float' else 'R04-api-list'
        target = new if label == 'viewport-float' else old
        tests = target['evidence'][name]['tests']
        result = tests[0]['results'][0]
        if label in ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'parallel-bool'):
            result[{'worker-bool': 'workerIndex', 'retry-bool': 'retry', 'parallel-bool': 'parallelIndex'}[label]] = False
        elif label.startswith('duration-'):
            result['duration'] = {'duration-string': 'NOT_A_DURATION', 'duration-bool': False,
                                  'duration-nan': float('nan'), 'duration-negative': -1}[label]
        elif label in ('errors-object', 'annotations-object', 'stdout-object', 'attachments-object'):
            result[label.split('-')[0]] = {}
        elif label == 'stderr-invalid-element':
            result['stderr'] = [{'text': False}]
        elif label == 'optional-error-wrong-type':
            tests[1]['results'][0]['error']['stack'] = []
        elif label == 'location-line-bool':
            tests[1]['results'][0]['errorLocation']['line'] = False
        elif label == 'empty-results':
            tests[0]['results'] = []
        elif label == 'viewport-float':
            item = next(item for item in result['attachments'] if item['name'] == 'browser-proof')
            proof = json.loads(base64.b64decode(item['body']))
            proof['viewport']['width'] = 800.0
            item['body'] = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(proof, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).decode()
        if label not in ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'parallel-bool', 'original', 'cases-object'):
            sidecar = target['artifacts'][name]['report.json']
            report = json.loads(sidecar['output'])
            for raw, evidence in zip(raw_tests(report), tests, strict=True):
                raw['results'] = copy.deepcopy(evidence['results'])
            sidecar['output'] = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
            sidecar['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(sidecar['output'].encode()).hexdigest()
        old_path, new_path = Path(directory) / 'historical.json', Path(directory) / 'recovery.json'
        old_path.write_text(json.dumps(old, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        # Repair the temporary envelope to ensure semantic validation is reached.
        new['historicalReceiptSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(old_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        new_path.write_text(json.dumps(new, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        argv = [sys.executable, '-B', str(root / 'audit.py'), '--verify-only', '--historical-receipt', str(old_path), '--recovery-receipt', str(new_path)]
        if label == 'cases-object':
            # Import avoids altering the fixed native manifest; exercise its entry contract.
            argv = [sys.executable, '-B', '-c', 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import audit; m,r,_=audit.load_inputs(audit.ROOT/"capture-receipt.json", audit.ROOT/"browser-recovery-receipt.json"); m["cases"]={}; audit.check(m,r)', str(root)]
        proc = subprocess.run(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10)
        output = proc.stdout.decode()
        if before or label == 'original':
            assert proc.returncode == 0 and '14 cases' in output, (label, output)
        else:
            expected_name = 'native cases' if label == 'cases-object' else name + ':'
            assert proc.returncode != 0 and expected_name in output, (label, output)
            assert 'historical receipt envelope mismatch' not in output, (label, output)
        controls.append({'mutation': label, 'case': name if label != 'original' else 'all 14',
                         'exit': proc.returncode, 'argv': argv, 'output': output,
                         'outputSha256': hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout).hexdigest(), 'recomputedTemporaryEnvelope': True})
        print(label, 'exit', proc.returncode)

results = [result for receipt in (old_input, new_input) for case in receipt['evidence'].values()
           for test in case['tests'] for result in test['results']]
initial = json.loads(json.loads((root / 'browser-recovery-initial-failure.json').read_text())['report'])
initial_results = [result for test in raw_tests(initial) for result in test['results']]
domains = {'manifestWorkerIndices': sorted({result['workerIndex'] for result in results}),
           'manifestParallelIndices': sorted({result['parallelIndex'] for result in results}),
           'initialTimeoutResults': [{key: result[key] for key in ('workerIndex', 'parallelIndex', 'retry', 'status', 'duration')} for result in initial_results]}
print('Captured native domains:', domains)
receipt = {'scope': 'read-time native field type process controls; no producer execution',
           'auditAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'beforeRepair': before,
           'auditRecipeSha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'audit.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           'controlRecipe': {'output': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
           'capturedDomains': domains, 'restoration': 'temporary records disposed; native inputs untouched', 'controls': controls}
if (root / 'audit_types.py').exists():
    receipt['typeHelperSha256'] = hashlib.sha256((root / 'audit_types.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    receipt['sourceLines'] = {name: len((root / name).read_text().splitlines()) for name in ('audit.py', 'audit_types.py')}
    assert all(0 < count < 400 for count in receipt['sourceLines'].values()), receipt['sourceLines']
    print('Auditor source lines:', receipt['sourceLines'])
if before:
    (scratch / 'R04-type-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
else:
    receipt['priorBlindControls'] = json.loads((scratch / 'R04-type-before.json').read_text())
    (root / 'audit-type-controls-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')

"""Temporary JSON process controls; --before records prior auditor blind spots."""
import base64
import copy
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

root = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode/lean-native-v2-R04/fixtures/profiles/playwright')
scratch = Path('/var/folders/lt/z11pyzhj0m17vn798jkk69hh0000gn/T/opencode')
before = '--before' in sys.argv
old_input = json.loads((root / 'capture-receipt.json').read_text())
new_input = json.loads((root / 'browser-recovery-receipt.json').read_text())
labels = ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'duration-string', 'errors-object', 'annotations-object', 'viewport-float')
if not before:
    labels += ('parallel-bool', 'duration-bool', 'duration-nan', 'duration-negative', 'stdout-object',
               'stderr-invalid-element', 'attachments-object', 'optional-error-wrong-type', 'location-line-bool',
               'empty-results', 'cases-object')
controls = []

def raw_tests(report):
    tests = []
    def visit(suites):
        for suite in suites:
            visit(suite.get('suites', []))
            for spec in suite.get('specs', []):
                tests.extend(spec['tests'])
    visit(report['suites'])
    return tests

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='R04-type-controls-', dir=scratch) as directory:
    for label in (*labels, 'original'):
        old, new = copy.deepcopy(old_input), copy.deepcopy(new_input)
        name = 'R04-browser-success-list' if label == 'viewport-float' else 'R04-api-list'
        target = new if label == 'viewport-float' else old
        tests = target['evidence'][name]['tests']
        result = tests[0]['results'][0]
        if label in ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'parallel-bool'):
            result[{'worker-bool': 'workerIndex', 'retry-bool': 'retry', 'parallel-bool': 'parallelIndex'}[label]] = False
        elif label.startswith('duration-'):
            result['duration'] = {'duration-string': 'NOT_A_DURATION', 'duration-bool': False,
                                  'duration-nan': float('nan'), 'duration-negative': -1}[label]
        elif label in ('errors-object', 'annotations-object', 'stdout-object', 'attachments-object'):
            result[label.split('-')[0]] = {}
        elif label == 'stderr-invalid-element':
            result['stderr'] = [{'text': False}]
        elif label == 'optional-error-wrong-type':
            tests[1]['results'][0]['error']['stack'] = []
        elif label == 'location-line-bool':
            tests[1]['results'][0]['errorLocation']['line'] = False
        elif label == 'empty-results':
            tests[0]['results'] = []
        elif label == 'viewport-float':
            item = next(item for item in result['attachments'] if item['name'] == 'browser-proof')
            proof = json.loads(base64.b64decode(item['body']))
            proof['viewport']['width'] = 800.0
            item['body'] = base64.b64encode(json.dumps(proof, separators=(',', ':')).encode()).decode()
        if label not in ('worker-bool', 'retry-bool', 'parallel-bool', 'original', 'cases-object'):
            sidecar = target['artifacts'][name]['report.json']
            report = json.loads(sidecar['output'])
            for raw, evidence in zip(raw_tests(report), tests, strict=True):
                raw['results'] = copy.deepcopy(evidence['results'])
            sidecar['output'] = json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n'
            sidecar['sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(sidecar['output'].encode()).hexdigest()
        old_path, new_path = Path(directory) / 'historical.json', Path(directory) / 'recovery.json'
        old_path.write_text(json.dumps(old, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        # Repair the temporary envelope to ensure semantic validation is reached.
        new['historicalReceiptSha256'] = hashlib.sha256(old_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        new_path.write_text(json.dumps(new, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
        argv = [sys.executable, '-B', str(root / 'audit.py'), '--verify-only', '--historical-receipt', str(old_path), '--recovery-receipt', str(new_path)]
        if label == 'cases-object':
            # Import avoids altering the fixed native manifest; exercise its entry contract.
            argv = [sys.executable, '-B', '-c', 'import sys; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1]); import audit; m,r,_=audit.load_inputs(audit.ROOT/"capture-receipt.json", audit.ROOT/"browser-recovery-receipt.json"); m["cases"]={}; audit.check(m,r)', str(root)]
        proc = subprocess.run(argv, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=10)
        output = proc.stdout.decode()
        if before or label == 'original':
            assert proc.returncode == 0 and '14 cases' in output, (label, output)
        else:
            expected_name = 'native cases' if label == 'cases-object' else name + ':'
            assert proc.returncode != 0 and expected_name in output, (label, output)
            assert 'historical receipt envelope mismatch' not in output, (label, output)
        controls.append({'mutation': label, 'case': name if label != 'original' else 'all 14',
                         'exit': proc.returncode, 'argv': argv, 'output': output,
                         'outputSha256': hashlib.sha256(proc.stdout).hexdigest(), 'recomputedTemporaryEnvelope': True})
        print(label, 'exit', proc.returncode)

results = [result for receipt in (old_input, new_input) for case in receipt['evidence'].values()
           for test in case['tests'] for result in test['results']]
initial = json.loads(json.loads((root / 'browser-recovery-initial-failure.json').read_text())['report'])
initial_results = [result for test in raw_tests(initial) for result in test['results']]
domains = {'manifestWorkerIndices': sorted({result['workerIndex'] for result in results}),
           'manifestParallelIndices': sorted({result['parallelIndex'] for result in results}),
           'initialTimeoutResults': [{key: result[key] for key in ('workerIndex', 'parallelIndex', 'retry', 'status', 'duration')} for result in initial_results]}
print('Captured native domains:', domains)
receipt = {'scope': 'read-time native field type process controls; no producer execution',
           'auditAt': datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'beforeRepair': before,
           'auditRecipeSha256': hashlib.sha256((root / 'audit.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
           'controlRecipe': {'output': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
           'capturedDomains': domains, 'restoration': 'temporary records disposed; native inputs untouched', 'controls': controls}
if (root / 'audit_types.py').exists():
    receipt['typeHelperSha256'] = hashlib.sha256((root / 'audit_types.py').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
if before:
    (scratch / 'R04-type-before.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
else:
    receipt['priorBlindControls'] = json.loads((scratch / 'R04-type-before.json').read_text())
    (root / 'audit-type-controls-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')
